entry_criteria: Weekly BoS Up + Hot Theme + PASS decision (generates GREEN signal)
exit_criteria: Weekly BoS Down OR 20.0% trailing stop

themes.name: AI Power Infrastructure & Grid Modernization
themes.thesis_summary: AI's exponential growth is constrained by power availability, not compute or capital. With 68 GW needed by 2027 and grid connections taking 4-7 years, power infrastructure companies solving this bottleneck will see sustained multi-year demand with pricing power.
key_catalysts: AI data centers need 10-68 GW additional power by 2027
Trump's 300 GW nuclear capacity target by 2030
Grid connection wait times now 4-7 years in key regions

themes.name: Defense Supply Chain Solutions & Manufacturing
themes.thesis_summary: Defense spending surge is constrained by manufacturing capacity and supply chain resilience rather than budget allocation. Companies solving F-35 component shortages, ammunition production bottlenecks, and critical material sourcing will capture outsized demand.
key_catalysts: Russell 2000 A&D forecasted 358% earnings growth in 2025
Europe defense spending to double by 2030 ($650-750B)
DoD supply chain resilience programs ramping up

themes.name: Nuclear Renaissance & Uranium
themes.thesis_summary: Nuclear power is the only baseload clean energy source capable of meeting AI's 24/7 power demands at scale. With policy support, uranium supply constraints, and long development lead times, the sector offers multi-year growth with supply-demand imbalances.
key_catalysts: Trump targeting 300 GW new nuclear by 2030
Three Mile Island restart for Microsoft
18 GW annual nuclear capacity additions forecasted 2025-2040

themes.name: Critical Materials & Rare Earth Processing
themes.thesis_summary: China's rare earth restrictions expose critical Western vulnerabilities in AI, defense, and clean energy supply chains. Companies building processing capacity outside China will benefit from supply security premiums and government support.
key_catalysts: China rare earth export restrictions tightening
Defense Production Act applications for critical materials
AI chip advanced packaging bottlenecks

themes.name: Memory & Semiconductor Packaging
themes.thesis_summary: AI growth is constrained by memory bandwidth and advanced packaging capacity, not raw compute power. Companies addressing these specific bottlenecks will capture outsized demand as hyperscalers compete for limited supply.
key_catalysts: DRAM prices up 172% YoY in Q3 2025
Advanced packaging supply constraints for AI chips
Data center memory allocation heavily skewed to AI

themes.name: European Banks & Financial Services
themes.thesis_summary: European banks have broken decades of underperformance with 90% gains in 2025, but remain under-owned by global investors. Improving fundamentals from rate normalization and regional defense spending provide continued upside.
key_catalysts: Euro STOXX Banks up 90% in 2025
Rising net interest margins in Europe
European defense spending boom supporting regional economy

themes.name: Healthcare & Biotechnology Recovery
themes.thesis_summary: Healthcare sector showing improving earnings revisions after period of underperformance. Obesity drugs and longevity treatments creating new growth vectors while AI accelerates drug discovery timelines.
key_catalysts: Healthcare seeing largest upward earnings revisions
Obesity drug market disruption creating new opportunities
AI-aided drug discovery accelerating development
